Package com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.fluid

Class FluidTransactions

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.fluid.FluidTransactions
public final class FluidTransactions extends Object
Loader-neutral fluid transactions for Big, Huge, and Source Buckets after an item or dispenser selects a gesture, plus vanilla-contract world pickup and fixed-water placement.

Sided block storage, arbitrary-fluid world placement, per-fluid sounds, and native powder-snow finalization are loader primitives on BucketOperations; this class applies admission, the SBPolicy allowlist, protection, bucket debit or credit, and player observability around them. Each operation previews, authorizes the exact target, and only then mutates. A true result means an accepted client prediction or a completed server transaction.

  • Finite Big and Huge Bucket transactions take and place one unit, crediting or debiting the bucket; powder snow moves one block.
  • Source Bucket transactions assign an empty bucket, sink matching input, and place without depleting; the assignment never changes on a take or place.
  • World pickup removes one bucket volume through the block's own BucketPickup contract: a source block is removed, a waterlogged block keeps itself and loses only its fluid, and a block that refuses pickup keeps its fluid.
  • Water placement serves the fixed water output aquatic Mob Bucket release requires; arbitrary fluid output stays loader-owned so each loader's fluid metadata remains authoritative. The position that would actually be changed is authorized, so a neighbor reached by fall-through is authorized in its own right.

      Tries infinite output from an assigned Source Bucket with explicit authorization identity.

      A sided store has priority; a present non-cauldron store that refuses is authoritative and blocks world fall-through. A cauldron is served by Cauldrons.place(net.minecraft.world.level.Level, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos, net.minecraft.core.Direction, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack, com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.interaction.Cauldrons.CauldronFluid, com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.protection.ProtectionContext). Otherwise the loader's arbitrary-fluid world placement runs. The bucket is never debited.

      true for an accepted client prediction or a completed server transaction

    • takeWorldFluid

      public static boolean takeWorldFluid(net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos pos, StoredFluid expected, @Nullable net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player player)
      Removes one bucket volume of expected from the block at pos through its own BucketPickup.pickupBlock(net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player, net.minecraft.world.level.LevelAccessor, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos, net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState) contract, then plays the block's pickup sound and emits the fluid-pickup game event.       Reports whether placing fluid in level evaporates instead of forming a block, matching vanilla's ultra-warm-dimension water rule. Loaders with a fluid-specific vaporization policy (Forge's FluidType#isVaporizedOnPlacement) should defer to it instead of this fallback.

    • resolveWorldTarget

      public static net.minecraft.core.BlockPos resolveWorldTarget(net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, @Nullable net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player player, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos pos, net.minecraft.core.Direction face, boolean mayFallThrough, net.minecraft.world.level.material.Fluid fluid)
      Resolves the position that would actually be written by placing fluid at pos along face.

      Read-only: does not check protection or touch the world.

      Parameters:
      level - level to inspect
      player - player used for liquid-container placement checks, or null
      pos - clicked position
      face - clicked face, used for fall-through to the neighbor
      mayFallThrough - whether an invalid clicked position may resolve to the neighbor
      fluid - fluid being placed
      Returns:
      pos itself when it is air, replaceable, or a liquid-container block that accepts the fluid; the neighbor along face when fall-through is allowed and the neighbor qualifies; otherwise pos unchanged, so the caller always gets a single position to report even when the eventual placement attempt will fail there

    • canHoldPlacedFluid

      public static boolean canHoldPlacedFluid(net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, @Nullable net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player player, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos pos, net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState state, net.minecraft.world.level.material.Fluid fluid)

    • emptyWater

      public static boolean emptyWater(net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, ProtectionContext context, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos pos, net.minecraft.core.Direction face, boolean mayFallThrough)
      Places one bucket volume of water at pos along face using vanilla bucket target and replacement rules.

      If mayFallThrough is true, an invalid clicked position may resolve once to the neighbor along face; it does not make an otherwise invalid destination placeable. The resolved position is authorized before mutation. Ultra-warm evaporation is handled here; every other outcome — placing, waterlogging, or destroying a replaceable block with drops, plus the empty sound and fluid-place game event — is delegated to BucketItem's own emptyContents. The caller remains responsible for debiting any finite container and awarding item-use accounting.

      Parameters:
      level - acting level
      context - authorization identity
      stack - the bucket stack driving the placement
      pos - clicked position
      face - clicked face
      mayFallThrough - whether an invalid clicked position may resolve once to the neighbor
      Returns:
      true when the world transaction completed; false leaves the world unchanged
